main.description: An encrypted Circle post. The post body is ciphertext under the named Circle key version; only the reply reference and attachment blobs are visible to the service.

circleId.description: Stable Circle identity this post belongs to.

keyVersion.description: The Circle content-key version the ciphertext was encrypted under.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext of the post body.

sig.description: Author signature over the ciphertext and its binding fields, verifiable by members.

authorEpochHead.description: Head of the author epoch whose key produced the signature.

attachments.description: Encrypted attachment blobs. Per-blob keys travel inside the ciphertext.
